about: Bude Surfing Experience is a surf school led by head coach Scott, with a wider team of instructors. It teaches from trailers in the car parks at Summerleaze Beach in Bude and at Widemouth Bay. As well as surfing, it runs SUP and bodyboard sessions, and takes group bookings from parties, schools, clubs and companies.
offers: Daily 2.5-hour group sessions for all ages and abilities
Private and bespoke sessions for individuals, couples or families
Stag and hen, corporate, school, scout and university groups
Birthday parties for ages 8 and over
where: Trailer in Summerleaze Beach car park (by the beach entrance) or the main Widemouth Bay car park; arrive 10 minutes early
goodToKnow: All equipment is included in group sessions; bring swimwear, a towel and any essential medication
Children under 8 need a non-surfing adult with them, arranged when booking
At least one instructor for every eight learners in group sessions
Approved by Surfing England; instructors are DBS checked and hold lifeguard and surf coaching awards
season: Open all year; in July and August private sessions run at sunrise and sunset only
gaps: Cancellation terms are in a separate PDF that wasn't opened; the site mentions three locations but only two are named; the 'open all year' wording comes from the Visit Bude listing
